message: Good morning, citizens. Today's weather: clear skies, high of 22°C. Remember to check your neighborhood radiation shelter assignment. Stay informed, stay safe.
The Ministry of Civil Defense reminds all households: test your iodine pills monthly. Replace expired filters in your home ventilation units. Preparedness is patriotism.
Community bulletin: The eastern district water purification station will undergo maintenance Tuesday. Bring your own containers. Boil all water before consumption.
A message from the Bureau of Public Health: Annual thyroid screenings are now available at all district clinics. Early detection saves lives. Schedule yours today.
This is the National Weather Service. A cold front is moving in from the north. Residents in exposed areas should secure outdoor equipment and check heating fuel reserves.
Attention all units. Border surveillance reports increased activity in sector 7. Maintain elevated alert status. All leave canceled until further notice.
Logistics update: Fuel convoys to northern outposts depart at 0600 tomorrow. Escort teams report to motor pool at 0500. Standard radiation protocols in effect.
Signal intelligence briefing: Intercepted communications suggest enemy forces are repositioning artillery in the eastern corridor. All forward units take cover.
Medical corps advisory: Radiation sickness cases at field hospital delta have doubled this week. Requesting additional medical supplies and personnel. Priority one.
Training notice: All reservists in zones 4 through 9 report for refresher training next Monday. Bring your protective gear and dosimeters. No exceptions.
EMERGENCY ALERT. Fallout detected in your area. Seek shelter immediately. Seal all windows and doors. Do not go outside. Repeat: do not go outside.
This is not a test. Multiple detonations confirmed. All citizens proceed to designated shelters. Bring supplies for 72 hours. If you hear sirens, you have ten minutes.
Medical emergency broadcast. Radiation levels exceeding safe limits in districts 3, 5, and 8. Evacuation routes are marked. Follow the yellow lines. Do not use main roads.
Water contamination confirmed in sector 4 reservoir. Do not drink tap water. Use bottled or boiled water only. Purification tablets distributed at shelter entrances.
Attention survivors. Rescue teams are en route to your location. Stay in your shelters. Do not attempt to leave. Repeat: do not leave your shelters. Help is coming.
Food distribution update. Rationing is now in effect. Report to your district center at 0800 tomorrow with your identification cards. One meal per person per day.
Health advisory: Symptoms of radiation sickness include nausea, fatigue, and hair loss. If you experience these symptoms, report to the medical station immediately. Take iodine pills as directed.
Security bulletin. Looters have been reported in the southern districts. All citizens are advised to remain indoors after dark. Curfew is in effect from 2000 to 0600.
Weather update: A fallout storm is approaching from the west. Expected to arrive within six hours. Seal all shelters. Turn off ventilation systems. This is not a drill.
Communication breakdown reported in eastern sectors. If you are in zones 6, 7, or 9, you may experience radio static. Alternate frequencies are 91.3 and 95.7.
Warning: Artillery barrage detected. Impact zone: grid reference 47-82. All units in the area take cover immediately. Estimated duration: 20 minutes.
Troop movement reported. Enemy convoy heading north on highway 12. Speed: 40 kph. Estimated arrival at checkpoint alpha: 1400 hours. All units prepare to engage.
Air defense alert. Unidentified aircraft detected at bearing 270, range 50 kilometers. All units man anti-air positions. Prepare for possible strike.
Reconnaissance report. Enemy forces establishing forward operating base in sector 9. Estimated strength: battalion. Requesting air support. Priority: high.
Medical evacuation request. Field hospital gamma taking radiation casualties. Need transport to rear area. Urgent. Repeat: urgent.
Supply convoy ambush reported on route delta. Three vehicles disabled. Requesting immediate reinforcement. Enemy strength: unknown. Proceed with caution.
Chemical detection alert. Sensors indicate possible chemical agent in sector 3. All units don protective gear immediately. Await further instructions.
Night patrol report. Contact with enemy reconnaissance team at 0200 hours. Two casualties. Enemy withdrew to the east. Pursuit not recommended due to radiation levels.
Artillery adjustment. Battery 7 correcting fire mission. Danger close. All friendly units clear the target area. Repeat: clear the target area.
Command update. Strategic situation deteriorating. All units prepare for possible withdrawal to secondary defensive line. Hold current positions until further notice.
This is an automated emergency broadcast. Radiation levels in this area exceed safe limits. Do not enter without protective equipment. Repeat: do not enter without protective equipment.
Emergency water purification instructions. Boil all water for ten minutes. Add three drops of bleach per liter. Let stand for thirty minutes before consumption.
This is an automated shelter locator signal. If you can hear this broadcast, you are within range of a designated fallout shelter. Proceed to the nearest marked entrance.
Medical advisory: Iodine pills effective only if taken before radiation exposure. Do not take iodine if already exposed. Seek medical attention immediately.
Emergency food storage protocols. Canned goods safe for consumption if seals are intact. Discard any cans showing bulging, rust, or damage. When in doubt, do not consume.
This is an automated radiation monitoring station. Current readings: [DATA CORRUPTED]. Next update in six hours. Stay tuned to this frequency for further information.
Emergency shelter maintenance reminder. Check air filtration systems weekly. Replace filters when indicator shows red. Clean ventilation ducts monthly to prevent blockage.
Automated weather warning. Nuclear winter conditions persist. Average temperature: minus 15°C. Ensure adequate heating fuel. Conserve energy. Ration food supplies.
This is an automated survivor locator signal. If you are hearing this broadcast, transmit your location on frequency 99.0. Rescue teams will attempt contact.
Emergency medical protocol. For radiation sickness: rest, hydration, iodine if available. Seek medical shelter immediately. Do not attempt to treat severe cases without training.

Is anyone out there? This is... this is Maria. I'm in the old subway station on 5th street. I have water, but I need medicine. My daughter is sick. Please. If you can hear this...
Warning to all travelers. The highway north of the city is a death trap. Radiation levels off the charts. I lost two people there. Don't go north. Repeat: don't go north.
This is the Westside Collective. We have established a safe zone in the old library building. We have food, water, medical supplies. All survivors welcome. Frequency 91.3 for coordination.
Day 47. Still alive. Found an unlooted pharmacy in sector 6. Lots of medical supplies. But the radiation... my dosimeter won't stop clicking. I don't know how much longer...
To whoever is broadcasting on 102.1: We know you're there. We've been listening. If you're military, we need help. If you're not... who's running this frequency?
